text: {"lessons":["I should set position-size limits and review downside risk before buying; a few severe losses in A and C wiped out many small realized gains.","I should not sell a holding only after a steep loss or rebuy it soon after selling; I need a clear, forward-looking reason and consistent rules for each trade.","Frequent decisions and small wins do not guarantee a healthy portfolio, so I should track total account value, diversification, and the performance of my strategy over time."]}
